flow.description: this flow is used to load the transformed data into the dimensions and facts in the warehouse.
flow.name: Loading Flow

labels.label: This process group handles loading denormalized data into dimensions and fact in which each processor for dimension and fact
This processor is used to route data based on table name.

This processor is used to load the data into dim_customer. This loading successfully, the data will be routed to success relationship and send an email success. If fail, it will be routed to failure relationship, and then send an error email.

This processor is used to load the data into dim_warehouse. This loading successfully, the data will be routed to success relationship and send an email success. If fail, it will be routed to failure relationship, and then send an error email.

This processor is used to load the data into dim_sale_rep. This loading successfully, the data will be routed to success relationship and send an email success. If fail, it will be routed to failure relationship, and then send an error email.
This processor is used to data into smaller chunks.
